guideDescription: Complete these steps to learn the basics of PigCloud. Your progress is saved automatically.
guideStepUploadDesc: Drag a file onto the page or click the upload button in the toolbar.
guideStepFolderDesc: Use the New Folder button or right-click for the context menu.
guideStepPreviewDesc: Double-click an image, PDF, or text file to open the built-in preview.
guideStepSearchDesc: Type in the search bar to filter files as you type, or press Ctrl+K to focus it from anywhere.
guideStepTrashDesc: Open the trash, select a file, and click Restore to bring it back.
guideStepShareDesc: Right-click a folder and choose Share to invite another user.
guideStepPubliclinkDesc: Generate a shareable link for any file or folder from the context menu.
guideStepFavoriteDesc: Right-click a file or folder and choose Add to favorites to pin it for quick access.
guideStepShortcutsDesc: Press G then K to open the keyboard shortcuts reference.
guideStepThemeDesc: Open Settings > Appearance and pick a theme that suits you.
guideStepAssistantDesc: Open Max from your chats or the pig button in the corner to get help with your files.
guideStepAssistantDisabledDesc: The AI assistant is currently disabled. Enable it in Settings > Assistant, then open Max from your chats.
guideStep2faDesc: Open Settings > Authentication and set up TOTP or a security key for extra protection.
guideStepCliTitle: Generate an API key for the CLI
guideStepCliDesc: Open Settings > API Key, generate a key, and run "pc login" in your terminal to connect the CLI.
guideStepCustomthemeDesc: Open Settings > Appearance and design your own palette: pick a background, surface, primary and secondary color.
guideStepLinkoptsDesc: Open a share, generate a public link, then set a password or expiry to control access.
guideStepVersionsDesc: Right-click a file, open Details > Versions, and click Restore on an earlier version; compare them first if you like.
guideStepTerminalDesc: Click the terminal icon in the toolbar to run CLI commands without leaving the app.
guideStepMoveDesc: Select an item and choose Move to pick a destination, or drag it onto a folder in the grid or sidebar.
guideStepGalleryDesc: Open Gallery in the sidebar to see every photo and video on a date timeline.
guideStepChatDesc: Open chat from the toolbar, add a friend by username, and send an end-to-end encrypted message.

subscriptionCreditsA1: Credits are weighted, not raw token counts: each word the assistant writes costs about five times one of yours, and context it re-reads from its cache costs a tenth. A plain question is cheap; having it read a large file or run several commands in one turn costs many times more.

subscriptionFaq1Q: Can I change my plan at any time?
subscriptionFaq1A: Yes. A switch to another paid plan applies immediately, with the price difference charged or credited at once. Turning off auto-renewal takes effect at the end of your billing period.
subscriptionFaq2Q: What happens to my files if I downgrade?
subscriptionFaq2A: Your files stay and downloads keep working. If they exceed the new plan's storage limit, uploads stop until you free up space; after 30 days over the limit new shares and public links stop too, and after 180 days content above the limit can be removed once we have emailed you a final notice.
subscriptionFaq3Q: How do I cancel my subscription?
subscriptionFaq3A: Choose Stop renewal on this page or under Settings › Subscription. Your plan stays active until the end of the billing period, then your account moves to Free.
subscriptionFaq4Q: How does billing work with expansion packs?
subscriptionFaq4A: Your plan and any expansion packs are combined into one charge per billing period. On monthly billing, a Pro plan plus a 50 GB expansion pack is one payment each month; on an annual plan the packs are prepaid with the year. You can add or remove packs at any time.

assistantGreeting: Hi! I'm Max, your PigCloud assistant. Ask me anything about uploads, sharing, security, or navigating PigCloud!
chatMaxNotE2ee: Max is an AI. Messages go to PigCloud and Anthropic and are not end-to-end encrypted.
settingsAssistantEnabledDesc: Show Max in your chats and as a button in the corner
settingsAssistantAdvancedDesc: Allow Max to run commands on your account
settingsAssistantAdvancedWarning: Heads up: advanced features cannot preserve full file and account anonymity by design. Any command you enable can surface real data: file and folder names, the contents of files you ask Max to open, short excerpts from other files a listing or search turns up, account details via wh (including email and two-factor status), storage usage via du/st, current folder via wd, your activity feed via ac, and a public link's URL and access token via pl. All of that leaves the end-to-end encryption boundary and is sent to Anthropic's Claude API for processing.

settingsGalleryOcrNote: Text recognition runs entirely on your device. Your images never leave it unencrypted, and the recognized text is encrypted before it is stored with your search index. Turning this on downloads the recognition models (about 27 MB) the first time, then scans your existing images in the background, which can take a while on large libraries.

landingHeroTitle: Your files. Your keys. Your cloud.
landingHeroSubtitle: Encrypted cloud storage from Germany. Your files and their names are encrypted on your device. Free to start.
landingDemoFootYou: Names and contents are encrypted on your device before upload.
landingDemoFootServer: Random names, sealed contents. Without your keys, this is all there is.
landingDemoBubbleYou: Tap "Server sees" to look through our eyes.
landingDemoBubbleServer: All the server stores. It can't open any of it.
landingShowcaseTitle: A cloud that does more, without seeing more
landingShowcaseSubtitle: Chat, a photo library, an assistant and an editor for hundreds of file types, all under the same end-to-end encryption as your files.
landingTourMaxDesc: Max finds files, creates folders, moves things around, runs CLI commands and answers questions about your cloud. You decide which actions it may run on its own and which wait for your approval.
landingTourMaxPoint1: Lives in chat, with its own threads
landingTourMaxPoint2: Approval cards show every file before anything changes
landingTourMaxPoint3: No access to your files until you allow it
landingTourMaxAlt: The Max assistant in chat over the file browser: asked to file a track, it creates a Music subfolder and moves the file, each step shown with a check
landingTourChatTitle: Chat with friends, sealed end to end
landingTourChatDesc: Talk and share files right inside your cloud. Replies, Markdown, edits, deletions and read receipts are all end-to-end encrypted. The server only ever sees ciphertext.
landingTourChatPoint1: Compare safety numbers to verify a friend
landingTourChatPoint2: Unexplained key changes pause the chat and warn you
landingTourChatPoint3: Send files right in the conversation
landingTourChatAlt: Encrypted chat with a friend about a shared photo folder: Markdown, a quoted reply, read receipts and the lock badge on the conversation
landingTourGalleryDesc: Photos and videos line up by date on their own. Everything that sorts, groups or reads your pictures runs on your device.
landingTourGalleryPoint2: People: optional face grouping, on your device only
landingTourGalleryPoint3: Optional search for text inside screenshots and scans
landingTourGalleryAlt: PigCloud gallery: photos on a date timeline, with Timeline, Collections and People in the sidebar
landingTourShareTitle: Share without handing over the keys
landingTourShareDesc: Share folders with friends, or send a public link with a password, an expiry date, a download limit or a QR code.
landingTourSharePoint1: Recipients browse subfolders and download everything as a ZIP
landingTourSharePoint2: Recipients need no account; revoke a link any time
landingTourShareAlt: Share Folder dialog for Photos with a live public link, Copy and QR buttons, and Password, Expires and Download limit switches
landingTourPreviewTitle: Open {previewTypes}+ file types in the browser
landingTourPreviewDesc: Documents, spreadsheets, RAW photos, 3D models, e-books and archives open right in the preview, decrypted only on your device. Text, code, spreadsheets and SQLite databases you can edit and save back.
landingTourPreviewPoint1: Open several files side by side in tabs
landingTourPreviewPoint2: Photo looks and sliders, saved as a new version
landingTourPreviewPoint3: Slideshow, Present mode and picture-in-picture video
landingTourPreviewAlt: A photo open in the PigCloud preview with the Look panel showing the Warm preset and brightness, contrast, saturation and warmth sliders
landingTourUploadDesc: Drag in or paste whole folders. PigCloud encrypts and uploads in parallel chunks and shows the queue live.
landingTourUploadPoint1: Picks up where it left off after a dropped connection
landingTourUploadPoint2: Asks before overwriting, or keeps both
landingTourUploadPoint3: Every file signed with a post-quantum signature
landingTourUploadAlt: PigCloud upload queue: a video mid-upload, three name conflicts offering Replace, Keep both or Skip, and a live throughput graph
landingTourThemesDesc: Four built-in themes, or design your own palette and let PigCloud check its contrast. Six fonts including OpenDyslexic, and three text sizes.
landingTourThemesPoint1: Backgrounds: Mesh, Aurora, Particles or Dot grid
landingTourThemesAlt: PigCloud appearance settings: theme cards for Auto, Light, Dark, Mocha and Pig plus a New theme slot, and six font cards including OpenDyslexic
landingSpacesTitle: Shared drives for the people you trust
landingSpacesLead: A space is an encrypted drive for your family, band or team. Everyone in it sees everything in it, and nobody outside can read it, including us.
landingSpacesPoolDesc: that members chip into from their own plans
landingSpacesInviteDesc: that carry the key and expire
landingSpacesKeysDesc: that the owner can rotate at any time
landingSpacesFine: Creating a space needs a paid plan. Joining one is free.
landingAppsLead: The same encryption on every device. Your files decrypt where you open them, never on the server.
landingCliCardDesc: Upload, share, sync and even chat from the terminal on Windows, macOS and Linux. Or skip the install and open the web terminal in your browser.
landingAndroidDesc: On Google Play. Snap photos straight into your cloud, share to PigCloud from any app and lock it with your fingerprint. The iOS app is in testing.
landingAndroidAlt: PigCloud on a phone: folders and photo thumbnails in a three-column grid, with the bottom bar for Menu, Home, Gallery, Upload and Chats
landingDesktopDesc: Keep a real folder in sync, or mount a drive that fetches files when you open them. Windows, macOS and Linux.
landingVersionsDesc: Edits keep the previous version. Compare any two and restore single blocks or the whole file.
landingSearchDesc: Name search matches initials and survives typos. Content search reads inside documents, PDFs and archives through a sealed index only your keys open.
landingRenameTitle: Rename a hundred files at once
landingRenameDesc: Rename a whole selection with numbers, the old name or the file type as placeholders, and check the live preview first.
landingHowLead: Your keys are made and kept on your devices. Three steps, and the server never holds anything it can read.
landingStep1Short: Your keys are generated on your device.
landingStep2Short: Files and names are sealed before they leave.
landingStep3Short: Decrypted on your device, never on the server.
landingFlowDeviceKeys: Generates your keys and a recovery key
landingFlow1Caption: Sign up for free. Your encryption keys are generated on your device, you get a recovery key to keep somewhere safe, and signing in works without ever sending your password.
landingFlow2Caption: Files and their names are encrypted and signed before upload. The server stores ciphertext it cannot open.
landingFlow3Caption: Open your files on the web, your phone, the CLI or the desktop app. They decrypt on your device, never on the server.
landingControlTitle: The small things that keep it yours
landingControlRecoveryDesc: Forgot your password? Your recovery key gets you back in. Rotate your keys any time and every file is resealed.
landingControlPasskeysDesc: Sign in with a passkey or add a second factor on top of your password.
landingControlLockDesc: Your keys lock after a set idle time on the web. On Android, the app can ask for your fingerprint.
landingControlActivityDesc: Even your own history is encrypted. We can't read the file names in it.
landingControlNotifyDesc: In the app, on your phone or by email, set per event. Security alerts always get through.
landingControlExportDesc: Download all your files decrypted, with their real names, as one ZIP. A GDPR data export is one click away.
landingControlShortcutsDesc: Move, preview, rename and play without touching the mouse.
landingPricingSubtitle: Start free. Paid plans add space and speed, never extra encryption.
pricingPacksLead: Add one or more packs to a paid plan. They bill together with your plan, and you can remove them at any time.
landingPricingExpansion: Need more room? Add storage packs from {packMin} to {packMax} to any paid plan.
landingFaq1A: No, not your stored files or their names. One exception: each upload's malware scan (below).
landingFaq2Q: What happens if I forget my password?
landingFaq2A: Use the recovery key from sign-up. Without it or your password, nobody, us included, can recover files.
landingFaq3Q: Is there a file size limit?
landingFaq3A: Files up to {maxUploadSize}; interrupted uploads resume.
landingFaq4A: On dedicated hardware in Germany. Requests pass through Cloudflare; the optional Max assistant uses Anthropic (US).
landingFaq5Q: Can I share storage with my family or team?
landingFaq5A: Yes, with a space: up to {spaceMembers} people, its own keys, one storage pool. Creating one takes at least {spaceMinStake} from a paid plan; joining is free.
landingFaq6Q: How does sharing work with E2EE?
landingFaq6A: Shares are re-sealed for the recipient on your device; link keys never reach us.
landingFaq7A: Cards, SEPA Direct Debit, Apple Pay and Google Pay via Stripe; we never see your card number.
landingFaq8Q: Can I leave and take my files with me?
landingFaq8A: Yes. Download everything decrypted, with the real file and folder names, as one ZIP, and request a full export of your account data under GDPR articles 15 and 20.
landingIncludedLabel: On every plan, including the free tier:
landingFaq9Q: How does PigCloud check uploads for malware if files are encrypted?
landingFaq9A: Your browser gives our scanner a one-time key; it checks the file in memory, never on disk. It has no hardware isolation, so root on the server could see it.
landingFaq10Q: Is PigCloud ready for quantum computers?
landingFaq10A: Yes. Key exchange and signatures pair a classical and a NIST post-quantum algorithm; breaking one is not enough.

landingCtaBannerSubtitle: Get {freeTierStorage} of end-to-end encrypted storage for free, and bring the people you share with.
